verses.restored: Praise ye YHWH. Blessed is the man that feareth YHWH, that delighteth greatly in his commandments.

familiar.text: Praise ye the LORD. Blessed is the man that feareth the LORD, that delighteth greatly in his commandments.

familiar.text: His seed shall be mighty upon earth: the generation of the upright shall be blessed.

verses.restored: Wealth and riches shall be in his house: and his righteousness endureth for ever.

familiar.text: Wealth and riches shall be in his house: and his righteousness endureth for ever.

verses.restored: To the upright there ariseth light in the darkness: he is gracious, and full of compassion, and righteous.

familiar.text: Unto the upright there ariseth light in the darkness: he is gracious, and full of compassion, and righteous.

verses.restored: A good man sheweth favour, and lendeth: he will guide his affairs with discretion.

familiar.text: A good man sheweth favour, and lendeth: he will guide his affairs with discretion.

familiar.text: Surely he shall not be moved for ever: the righteous shall be in everlasting remembrance.

verses.restored: He shall not be afraid of evil tidings: his heart is fixed, trusting in YHWH.

verses.restored: His heart is established, he shall not be afraid, until he see his desire upon his enemies.

translation_notes: This chapter completes corpus coverage as a ChatGPT-authored draft. KJV is retained as a familiar comparison layer; a separate automated reference pass adds BSB and pointed Hebrew without replacing the restored draft.
safety_note: Wealth language is wisdom imagery, not a prosperity guarantee; poverty is never proof of divine disfavor.
source_witness_audit_flags: Compare directly with WLC/OSHB, Septuagint, Dead Sea Psalms witnesses where extant, and other textual witnesses during the global audit. Preserve poetic parallelism, superscriptions, acrostic structure, duplicate/reused psalms, and significant Hebrew/Greek divergences rather than harmonizing them.
